title: Make an Agent Skill Activate for the Right Requests
domain: Routing code-change reviews without colliding with implementation, release communication, incident reporting, or document review
mission: Measure a vague skill description, repair only its trigger boundary, and prove the change with repeated train and held-out decisions.
outcome: The real description activates for evidence-backed review of supplied code changes and abstains for neighboring workflows.
seededDefects: description does not identify code artifacts
description collides with summaries and implementation work
verificationGates: three decisions per request and description
provider, environment, timestamp, and response-hash parity
npm run verify:exercise checks protected inputs, implementation quality, and required submission evidence.
committed snapshot, skill-use transcript, and capture freshness
agentWorkflow: select using held-out score and stability
workingDeliverables: actual skill-creator session and source record
committed artifact manifest and captured final verification
masterySignals: fair repeated comparison with reproducible routing provenance
measured adoption or rejection against a strong baseline
